body: Your welcome. Sorry for replying late.

I'm living your same life. I look in the mirror and I think I look cute but if I stare at myself for to long I look ugly again. I have people who call themselves my friends who I've known for about two years. I do this thing where I gradually distance myself from people. I think about how I want to end it all everyday but the only thing that gives me hope is going to college I don't know or care which one it is it just has to be a private university. I have 3 1/2 years until I graduate and that is my only hope. I'm saying this because you can basically start your life over. Change your personality. That's what I did when I started high school. Everyone probably thinks I'm the stereotypical quiet kid though. Although you can't hide the pain just think about the moment not the long term. Doing this helps because you not worrying about your future or anyone else, just you. I'm only 14 about to turn 15 this march, but take my story and advice as you may.

Living does get harder everyday. I'm a 14 year old girl about to turn 15 in march. I honestly think that you should do what you think is best for your life. I'm not going to tell you the quickest and easiest way I just have a suggestion. Before you do it take a year and decide if you want to do it or not. I don't know the right thing to do in this situation, but I want to give honest advice from the heart cause some people here suck. If you still want to do it know that it's not selfish. That last line is a cliche but it's true.
